author: Pqthon
body:
My minecraft IGN: iPython
It says I was banned for: Click Aimbot
I was not hacking, I'm also a YT (only 14 subs right now) and I think I would get more views, by playing on Avicus. For Avicus has very fun game modes (I especially love Nebula). And when I got banned, I was devastated... I haven't played on this server for more than two years. This was the first server I was ever on. And I loved playing on it... please unban me.
